description: Submit a phone-consultation / quote request to WOOKANG TECH (우강테크) on behalf of the user. A staff member calls the user back within 1 business day (weekdays) to say whether it can be done and the approximate price. IMPORTANT: call ONLY after the user has explicitly agreed that WOOKANG TECH may use their phone number to call them back — then set consent=true. Never call with made-up or test numbers. Ask for the phone number if you do not have it. Include what_where (what to show and where), and size/place if known, so the staff can prepare. 반드시 사용자에게 전화번호 사용 동의를 받은 뒤 호출하세요. 문의를 넣기 전에 반드시 사용자에게 "우강테크가 전화 상담을 위해 이 전화번호를 쓰는 것"에 동의하는지 묻고, 동의한 경우에만 consent:true 로 보낸다. 동의 없이 보내면 400 으로 거절된다.

agent_name.description: Name of the AI assistant submitting (e.g. "ChatGPT", "Claude")

consent.description: true only if the user explicitly agreed to be called back on this number (개인정보 수집·이용 동의).

org.description: Organization / shop name if the user gave one

phone.description: User's Korean phone number, mobile preferred (e.g. 010-1234-5678). Landline with area code also accepted.

what_where.description: What to display and where, in the user's words (무엇을 어디에). e.g. "학교 정문, 행사 안내"

name: submit_inquiry
title: 우강테크에 전화 상담 신청
